name: Titan Forest: Survival Shooter
summary:
Enter a brutal open-world VR survival adventure where every decision matters. Hunt humanoid creatures, track monstrous worm beasts, gather wood, craft weapons, and build a safe house before night falls. In this action survival game, you must scavenge resources, upgrade your gear, and fight to stay alive in a hostile forest.
